text_block_list.text:
One day, on my way to the academy, I saw 
someone hurriedly jump into a taxi at the 
school gate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Hey, you. Did any reporters 
come this way?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Curses, already outside the academy 
grounds...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
He came to take photos of our training, 
and the jerk used flash photography!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though I made a point of explicitly 
telling them not to use flash photography 
during the pre-meeting!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I need to call and lodge a protest 
with the publisher later...!

Perhaps from chasing after the reporters 
with all her might, Air Groove looked a 
bit exhausted.
